title: Zesty Turkish Prawns Borek
description: A zesty Turkish prawn borek that marries succulent prawns with flaky phyllo and a bright lemon‑garlic sauce, perfect for a low‑sodium date‑night dinner.
instructions: Thaw the prawns in the refrigerator for 8–10 hours or under cold running water for 20 minutes.
Pat the prawns dry with paper towels and season lightly with pepper.
In a small bowl mix the olive oil, minced garlic, dill, lemon zest, lemon juice, and soy sauce.
Fold the seasoned prawns in the mixture until well coated and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Preheat the Robata grill to high heat, about 200°C.
Cut each phyllo sheet in half lengthwise to create long strips.
Place a handful of coated prawns on a strip, roll the phyllo around the prawns, and seal the edge with a dab of butter.
Arrange the rolls on the grill, close the lid, and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and prawns reach 62°C internal temperature.
Brush the finished borek with remaining butter and garnish with extra dill if desired.
Serve hot as a flavorful, low-sodium dinner.
